An '''individual''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] and the granddaughter of a [[Unidentified grandfather (Asajj Ventress)|former member]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]' [[Confederacy military|military]] who had fought in the [[Clone Wars]]. They resided at a [[Unidentified grandfather's farm|farm]] on a [[Unidentified desert world|desert planet]], far away from the [[Galactic Empire]]. During this time, they came into conflict with a group of raiders over the [[Unidentified spring (Cipher Canyon)|water spring]] in the area. After [[Asajj Ventress]] and [[Lyco Strata]] visited the planet they helped them to be peace and the raiders share their water with them.<ref name="Warrior" />
